## Safety

- [ ] One scoped task only; no unrelated refactor
- [ ] No direct public URL, slug, canonical or redirect change unless explicitly approved
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or private backups committed
- [ ] Image publication rights confirmed (if applicable)
- [ ] Historical content is source-backed; no invented copy/facts/dates
- [ ] Shared image impact checked and documented

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify:paul`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Vercel Preview checked on desktop
- [ ] Vercel Preview checked on mobile
- [ ] Target page canonical/indexability checked
